conflicts.description: FY2026 fees for Bob Moritz and Brian Niccol: the 2026 proxy's Director Compensation table prints $108,751 for each (and totals of $339,604 and $338,761 that add up from it), but the fees-election sub-table in the same proxy shows $108,571 for each, the same figure as Cesar Conde and Marissa Mayer, who held the same plain-member role. $108,571 is probably the correct figure and 108,751 a digit transposition, which would make the totals $339,424 and $338,581. Which special litigation committee Randall Stephenson served on (FY2024 $11,703, FY2025 $20,000) is not named in the director compensation section of either proxy.

coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-04-23, 2020-04-23, 2021-04-22, 2022-04-21, 2023-04-20, 2024-04-25, 2025-04-24, 2026-04-23), one table per fiscal year FY2019-FY2026: 89 rows (12, 11, 10, 11, 11, 10, 12, 12). Every table has Fees Earned or Paid in Cash, Stock Awards, All Other Compensation and Total columns except FY2021 (no All Other column); option, non-equity incentive and pension/NQDC columns are omitted in every year and recorded as 0. Every row's components equal its printed total. Employee directors (McMillon; Furner in FY2026) are excluded by the proxies. No 10-K/A, DEFR14A or second DEF 14A was filed in the period; the DEFA14A filings and the 2026 PRE 14A were not used. Fiscal years end January 31 per each 10-K cover (d201-d208). Directors who left before 2020 (Cash, Systrom, Easterbrook) are not in the board file and were given new keys with CIKs from their Forms 3/4 (d211-d213).
